def solve(G):
    R,C=len(G),len(G[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in G]
    linrows=[r for r in range(R) if any(G[r][c]==9 and G[r][c+1]==9 for c in range(C-1))]
    lincols=[c for c in range(C) if any(G[r][c]==9 and G[r+1][c]==9 for r in range(R-1))]
    for r in linrows:
        ns=[c for c in range(C) if G[r][c]==9]
        for a,b in zip(ns,ns[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=2
    for c in lincols:
        ns=[r for r in range(R) if G[r][c]==9]
        for a,b in zip(ns,ns[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=2
    return out

# Verify rule on all 7 demo pairs: fill bg cells on bbox border lines + interior lines with >=4 dashes
import copy
def solve_rule(g, line_col=None):
    g = [row[:] for row in g]
    vals = [v for row in g for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    nines = [(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    lc = line_col or nines[0][0] if False else None
    # line color = most common non-bg color? dashes are all same color; fill is 2
    nbg = [v for v in vals if v!=bg]
    lc = max(set(nbg), key=nbg.count) if nbg else None
    fill = [v for v in set(nbg) if v!=lc][0] if len(set(nbg))>1 else 2
    rows9 = sorted({r for r,c in nines}); cols9 = sorted({c for r,c in nines})
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rows9),max(rows9),min(cols9),max(cols9)
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    # border lines
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for r in (r0,r1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    # interior lines with >=4 dashes: fill gaps between min and max dash
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        ds = [c for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==lc]
        if len(ds)>=4:
            for c in range(min(ds),max(ds)+1):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    for c in range(c0+1,c1):
        ds = [r for r in range(len(g)) if g[r][c]==lc]
        if len(ds)>=4:
            for r in range(min(ds),max(ds)+1):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    return out
